detail.readme:
dukascopy-node

✨ Download free historical and real-time market price tick data ✨
Stocks • Crypto • Commodities • Bonds • Currencies • CFDs • ETFs
via Node.js and CLI

📚 Documentation

MCP Docs (via Context7 MCP)

*** ## 🚀 Installation
npm yarn pnpm 
npm install dukascopy-node --save
 
yarn add dukascopy-node
 
pnpm add dukascopy-node
> [!IMPORTANT] > Node.js 20 or higher is required. ### Browser setup Downloads may require Chromium or Google Chrome. If Chrome is not installed, install Chromium once on Windows, macOS, or Linux: ```sh npx dukascopy-node --install-browser ``` For a project with the package already installed, use `npx dukascopy-node --install-browser`. On Linux, add `--with-deps` to install required system libraries. Run setup again if an upgrade asks for a newer browser. The browser runs in the background. ### HTTP 403 and browser challenges An explicit AWS WAF challenge can start browser recovery. A **403 without a challenge** stops the download: no further requests, ordinary retries, or browser recovery start for it. With the default `failAfterRetryCount: true`, it raises `DukascopyAccessDeniedError` (`code: 'DUKASCOPY_ACCESS_DENIED'`, `status: 403`, `url`, and `source`, which is `'browser'` when the headless browser was refused). Cached tokens are kept, because a plain 403 does not show that a token is invalid. The next `getHistoricalRates` call or CLI run starts fresh. If this happens, check that Dukascopy's [historical data export page](https://www.dukascopy.com/swiss/english/marketwatch/historical/) works in a regular browser, and update dukascopy-node. Reinstalling Chromium or deleting the token cache does not help with a plain 403. See [issue #264](https://github.com/Leo4815162342/dukascopy-node/issues/264). ## ✨ Download Historical Price Data via CLI ```bash npx dukascopy-node -i btcusd -from 2019-01-13 -to 2019-01-14 -t tick -f csv ``` ![dukascopy-node-1080p](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/12486774/210557823-63ba12f1-ab77-42ae-ad27-6c199b0c1fdb.gif) [🛠️ View full CLI specification](https://www.dukascopy-node.app/config/cli) --- ## ✨ Download Historical Price Data via Node.js ```javascript const { getHistoricalRates } = require('dukascopy-node'); (async () => { try { const data = await getHistoricalRates({ instrument: 'btcusd', dates: { from: new Date('2019-01-13'), to: new Date('2019-01-14') }, timeframe: 'tick', format: 'json' }); console.log(data); } catch (error) { console.log('error', error); } })(); ``` [🛠️ View full Node.js specification](https://www.dukascopy-node.app/config/node) ## ✨ Download Real-Time Price Data via Node.js ```javascript const { getRealTimeRates } = require('dukascopy-node'); (async () => { try { const data = await getRealTimeRates({ instrument: 'eurusd', timeframe: 'tick', format: 'json' }); console.log(data); } catch (error) { console.log('error', error); } })(); ``` [ℹ️ More Information](https://www.dukascopy-node.app/downloading-real-time-data) --- ##
